nodes.label: WASM compression — the biggest boot-latency lever
nodes.rationale: Download+compile of the ~4MB wasm binary is ~65-75% of time-to-interactive, so serving it compressed (gzip ~3.7x, brotli ~4.2x) is the single biggest boot-latency lever — bigger and far cheaper than shrinking the binary with TinyGo. Compression does not shrink the compiled module or the ~40ms Go runtime boot.
